(?P<skip>
	      (?<!\w)[eE]'(?:[^'\\]|''|\\.)*'    # escape string: a \' does not end it
	    | '(?:[^']|'')*'                     # string literal (only '' escapes a quote)
	    | "(?:[^"]|"")*"                     # quoted identifier
	    | \$(?P<tag>\w*)\$.*?\$(?P=tag)\$    # dollar-quoted string
	    | --[^\n]*                           # line comment
	    | /\*.*?\*/                          # block comment
	  )
	| \s(?P<negated>NOT\s+)?REGEXP\s
